lieu: small kitchen of a modest house in Treichville, Abidjan, a gas stove with a simmering pot, a wooden table with plantains, afternoon light through a small window

persos.nom: the worried boy in the rocket t-shirt
persos.desc: boy around 10, mustard-yellow t-shirt with a small rocket print, short hair, big round eyes
persos.pose: standing by the wooden table, looking up at his mother with a worried face

persos.nom: the mother in the turquoise boubou
persos.desc: mother in her 40s, wide turquoise boubou with white embroidery, a turquoise head tie of the same fabric, wooden spoon in her hand
persos.pose: standing at the stove stirring the pot, her face turned toward her son

dialogue: Maman, dis-moi la vérité dêh : on m'a adopté ?
Adopté ? Mon fils, si on avait choisi, on allait prendre un plus joli.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The boy keeps his face turned three-quarters toward the camera the whole time, so his face and moving lips are clearly visible while he asks with a worried, hopeful face; he never turns his back to the camera. The mother keeps stirring the pot and answers calmly and honestly, her face turned toward him.
chute: The mother keeps stirring as if nothing happened. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the boy's devastated face looking into the camera.

lieu: living room of a family house in Yopougon, Abidjan, a beige sofa, a low coffee table, a wall clock, evening lamp light

persos.nom: the curious little girl with the puffs
persos.desc: little girl around 7, two big afro puffs, lavender t-shirt with a white star, denim shorts
persos.pose: sitting on the sofa next to her mother, looking at her father

persos.nom: the mother with the very long braids
persos.desc: mother in her 30s with very long thin braids falling all the way down to her lower back, mint-green blouse, white trousers
persos.pose: sitting on the sofa, proudly stroking her long braids

persos.nom: the bald father reading the newspaper
persos.desc: father in his 40s, completely bald shiny head, burgundy linen shirt, reading glasses
persos.pose: sitting in an armchair in the right background, reading a newspaper, calm

dialogue: Maman, pourquoi papa n'a plus cheveux sur la tête ?
Parce qu'il réfléchit beaucoup, mon bébé.
Ahh… C'est pour ça toi tu as les cheveux jusqu'au dos dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The father keeps reading his newspaper silently. The girl asks innocently. The mother answers proudly, stroking her long braids. The girl thinks for a second, then looks at her mother's long braids.
chute: The mother freezes with her hand in her braids. In the background, the father slowly lowers his newspaper with a small smile. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the mother's offended face looking into the camera.

lieu: small courtyard of a house in Koumassi, Abidjan, plastic chairs, a clothesline with laundry, the house door on the left, late afternoon

persos.nom: the nervous father with the smartphone
persos.desc: father in his 50s, short grey beard, sky-blue shirt with a pen in the pocket, holding a smartphone in both hands
persos.pose: sitting on a plastic chair in the foreground, holding his phone toward his son, nervous

persos.nom: the teenage son in the lime hoodie
persos.desc: teenage boy around 15, lime-green hoodie, wireless headphones around his neck
persos.pose: sitting on a plastic chair next to his father, looking at the phone

persos.nom: the mother with the brand-new glasses
persos.desc: mother in her 50s, brand-new thick black glasses, coral-pink wrap dress, reading a newspaper
persos.pose: sitting on a bench in the left background near the door, reading a newspaper through her new glasses

dialogue: Mon fils, comment on supprime WhatsApp dêh ?
Pourquoi, papa ?
Ta mère-là a acheté des lunettes.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The mother keeps reading her newspaper silently in the background. The father whispers his question, nervous. The son asks why, then closes his mouth and only listens. The father, facing the camera, whispers the last line himself while the son keeps his mouth closed; the father glances over his shoulder at the mother.
chute: In the background, the mother slowly lowers her newspaper and stares at the father through her new glasses. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the father's panicked face looking into the camera.

lieu: dining room of a modest house in Adjamé, Abidjan, a small table with a plate of plain white rice, a kitchen doorway with a curtain in the background, midday

persos.nom: the visiting aunt with the golden handbag
persos.desc: plump visiting aunt in her 50s, glossy purple-and-gold brocade dress, big golden handbag on her lap, gold earrings
persos.pose: sitting at the table in front of a plate of plain white rice, smiling sweetly at the little girl

persos.nom: the little girl in the strawberry dress
persos.desc: little girl around 6, cherry-red smock dress with a small white strawberry print, two small braids with red beads
persos.pose: standing next to the aunt's chair, very happy

persos.nom: the mother holding the closed pot
persos.desc: mother in her 30s, simple navy-blue house dress, holding a closed cooking pot against her belly
persos.pose: standing in the kitchen doorway in the background, holding the closed pot, smiling politely

dialogue: Ma chérie, tu es contente que Tantie est venue, hein ?
Oui Tantie ! Maman a dit : quand tu viens, on cache la viande. Mais moi je vais te montrer où dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The aunt asks sweetly. The little girl answers with total innocence and a big smile, then points at the closed pot in her mother's hands.
chute: The aunt slowly turns her head toward the mother. The mother freezes in the doorway, hugging the closed pot. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the mother's horrified face looking into the camera.

lieu: small living room in Port-Bouët, Abidjan, a plastic table, a wall calendar, a standing fan, afternoon

persos.nom: the angry father with the exam paper
persos.desc: father in his 40s, thick moustache, olive-green safari shirt, holding up an exam paper marked with a big red 2
persos.pose: standing, holding up the exam paper, angry

persos.nom: the calm schoolgirl with the pink backpack
persos.desc: schoolgirl around 11, maroon-and-white checkered school uniform, pink backpack, neat cornrows
persos.pose: standing in front of her father, calm and confident

dialogue: Ta voisine-là a eu dix-huit, et toi tu as eu deux ! Pourquoi ?!
Papa, c'est pas ma faute dêh. Elle, ses parents sont intelligents.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The father shouts, shaking the exam paper. The schoolgirl answers calmly, as if it were obvious.
chute: The father slowly lowers the exam paper. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the father's speechless face looking into the camera.

lieu: quiet street of Cocody, Abidjan, in front of the tall white gate of a huge luxurious villa with palm trees, a shiny car parked inside behind the gate, sunny afternoon

persos.nom: the show-off in the silver suit
persos.desc: show-off man in his 30s, shiny silver suit a bit too small, fake gold chain, sunglasses pushed up on his head
persos.pose: standing in front of the villa gate, arm proudly stretched toward the villa

persos.nom: the impressed young woman in fuchsia
persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, elegant fuchsia bodycon dress, long straight wig, small white clutch bag
persos.pose: standing on his right, looking at the villa, impressed

persos.nom: the little boy with the bucket
persos.desc: little boy around 7, faded orange t-shirt, blue shorts, holding a plastic bucket with a big sponge
persos.pose: standing on the man's left, holding his bucket

dialogue: Bébé, tu vois cette grosse villa-là ? C'est chez moi dêh.
Ehh, vraiment ?
Papa, le patron a dit tu dois laver sa voiture avant six heures.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The man shows off proudly. The woman is amazed. The little boy speaks innocently, raising his bucket and sponge.
chute: The woman slowly turns her head toward the man. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the show-off's busted face looking into the camera.

lieu: living room of a well-kept family house in Marcory, Abidjan, a big brown leather armchair, a framed family photo on the wall, a doorway to the kitchen, evening

persos.nom: the skinny suitor with the guitar
persos.desc: very skinny young man in his 20s, oversized mustard corduroy jacket, short dreadlocks, an acoustic guitar on his back
persos.pose: standing in front of the armchair, hands joined, respectful and hopeful

persos.nom: the stern father in the armchair
persos.desc: stern father in his 60s, white beard, cream-coloured kaftan with gold embroidery, sitting in the leather armchair
persos.pose: sitting in the armchair, looking the suitor up and down

persos.nom: the daughter by the kitchen door
persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, cobalt-blue jumpsuit, short natural hair with a gold headband
persos.pose: standing by the kitchen doorway in the background, hands joined, hopeful

dialogue: Tonton, je veux marier votre fille.
Mon petit, tu fais quel travail ?
Je suis artiste-chanteur, Tonton.
Ma fille, va lui chercher à manger dêh. Il a faim.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The suitor asks respectfully. The father asks coldly. The suitor answers proudly, touching his guitar strap. The father answers with pity, gesturing toward the kitchen with one hand, without getting up.
chute: The daughter stays in the doorway, embarrassed. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the suitor's offended face looking into the camera.

lieu: cozy living room of an apartment in Riviera, Abidjan, at night, a grey sofa, a framed wedding photo on the wall, warm lamp light

persos.nom: the romantic husband in the bathrobe
persos.desc: chubby husband in his 40s, maroon velvet bathrobe, small round moustache, holding a cup of tea
persos.pose: sitting on the sofa, looking at his wife with dreamy romantic eyes

persos.nom: the wife scrolling on her phone
persos.desc: wife in her late 30s, peach satin pyjama top, silk bonnet on her head, scrolling on her phone
persos.pose: sitting on the other end of the sofa, scrolling on her phone, bored

dialogue: Ma chérie, parmi tous les gars d'Abidjan, pourquoi c'est moi tu as choisi ?
Mon vieux, à trente-neuf ans, on choisit plus dêh. On ramasse.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The husband asks romantically with dreamy eyes. The wife answers flatly without looking up from her phone.
chute: The wife keeps scrolling on her phone. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the husband's devastated face looking into the camera, his tea cup frozen in the air.
